_comment: SESSION-CTX-PROPAGATE: exact hooks.SubagentStart[] entry to MERGE into ~/.claude/settings.json. This registers a NEW SubagentStart hook -- the ONLY hook event whose additionalContext is injected into the SPAWNED sub-agent's own context (a PreToolUse:Agent hook's additionalContext goes to the parent, not the child, so it can never reach a sub-agent). Confirmed against Claude Code hooks docs. The matcher '*' matches ALL sub-agent types (Explore, Plan, general-purpose, custom). SubagentStart cannot block sub-agent creation, so this is inherently fail-open. If a hooks.SubagentStart array already exists, append this entry into it (do NOT add a second SubagentStart key). This does NOT touch the existing PreToolUse:Agent|Task nudge_background_agents.py hook -- that is a separate, unrelated block and stays as-is. Applied + verified by the MANAGER, not by this ticket's build session.
verify: spawn a real Agent/Task sub-session and confirm the additionalContext appears in the SUB-AGENT's context (not the parent's); confirm the existing PreToolUse background-agent nudge is unchanged
